title: 1, 2, 3 Bumper Game
description: A small-area possession game with a bumper support player. Teams battle 2-on-2, use the bumper for give-and-go support, and transition quickly from defense to offense.
coaching_points: Use the bumper to relieve pressure and create quick give-and-go plays.
Defenders protect the middle with active sticks.
Communicate early and move immediately after passing.
Transition quickly after winning a loose puck.

title: 2 on 2 Transition & Track
description: A continuous cross-ice 2-on-2 game where the defending team exits to waiting support players and the former offensive pair immediately tracks back into the next transition.
coaching_points: Attack the net quickly when possession is gained.
Track back through the middle with sticks in passing lanes.
Outlet players communicate and present clear targets.
Transition immediately after the breakout pass.

title: Swedish Transition Game
description: A continuous transition game where a defending pair must move the puck to teammates at the blue line before the new group attacks and the previous offensive players become trackers.
coaching_points: Make the transition pass quickly after possession changes.
Backcheck through the middle with active sticks.
Attackers support each other and get downhill quickly.
Players waiting at the blue line communicate and stay ready.

title: Alternate 1 on 1 x 3
description: A two-part end-zone progression that creates three different 1-on-1 situations, then builds the same setup into 2-on-1 and 2-on-2 support opportunities.
coaching_points: Defenders angle from inside-out with stick on puck.
Forwards protect the puck and attack available net lanes.
Use tight turns and support routes to create the next advantage.
Rotate quickly so the progression stays continuous.

title: Designated Shooters Umbrella Power Play Game
description: A small-area power-play game with umbrella support players at the point. Players work to move the puck quickly, find one-timers and tips, and battle for position around back-to-back nets.
coaching_points: Use point support and move immediately after passing.
Point players make quick decisions and look for shots or deflections.
Attackers establish net-front position for tips and rebounds.
Defenders box out and keep sticks in passing lanes.

title: Nobles 2 v 2 Transition Game
description: A continuous 2-on-2 game where defenders earn transition by moving the puck to teammates on the boards, who then enter as the new offensive pair.
coaching_points: Offense attacks the net and uses switches and exchanges.
Defense keeps the puck outside with sticks in lanes.
Move the puck to the board outlets immediately after winning possession.
Use quick catch-and-release shots in scoring areas.

title: Angling Through The Circles Progression
description: A cross-ice angling progression that begins 1-on-1 and can expand to 2-on-2 or 3-on-3. The defender must navigate the circles, match speed, and angle the puck carrier away from dangerous ice.
coaching_points: Match the puck carrier's speed before closing.
Lead with stick-on-puck pressure and finish with body position.
Supporting defenders are ready for loose pucks.
Transition immediately after a turnover.

title: Add-On Game
description: A possession game that starts 2-on-2 and rewards a team for completing passes to line players, allowing them to add teammates into the game and create an advantage.
coaching_points: Compete to establish first possession.
Support the puck and jump to open space.
Defenders keep sticks in lanes and force play outside.
Manage the puck well before trying to add another player.

title: 4 Corner Possession Game - Offensive Advantage
description: A 2-on-2 possession game with support players stationed in the offensive-side corners. Players use corner support, give-and-gos, point options, and net-front movement around back-to-back nets.
coaching_points: Use support players to create quick give-and-gos.
Jump to open space after moving the puck.
Create traffic, tips, and rebound opportunities at the net.
Defenders box out and protect passing lanes.

title: 4 Corner Possession Game - Defensive Advantage
description: A variation of the 4 Corner Possession Game with support players located on the defensive side of each team's zone, forcing players to use support and transition through pressure.
coaching_points: Use corner support to escape pressure and restart possession.
Defenders angle with active sticks and close interior lanes.
Offensive players move after passes and use the nets as space.
Communicate constantly in the fast-changing possession game.

title: Gretzky 2 vs. 2 Game
description: A 2-on-2 small-area game with dedicated support players stationed behind each offensive net. The setup encourages give-and-gos, deception, and creative use of the space behind the goal.
coaching_points: Players in the middle pass and immediately get open.
Support players behind the net scan before receiving.
Use the net as protection and change the point of attack.
Defenders keep heads on a swivel and sticks in lanes.

title: 1 on 1, 2 on 2, 3 on 3 Battle Drill
description: A progressive defensive-zone battle that begins 1-on-1, adds a second pair, then finishes 3-on-3 below the circles to reinforce man-on-man coverage, communication, and puck protection.
coaching_points: Offensive players protect possession below the tops of the circles.
Defenders stay connected to checks and communicate through each progression.
Centers work down low with the defense as the third pair joins.
Compete for loose pucks and maintain position around the net.

title: Four Corners Possession Game
description: A possession game with four stationary support boxes. The active players score points by completing clean passes to teammates in the designated corner areas while protecting possession under pressure.
coaching_points: Play with the head up to find support early.
Protect the puck until a clean passing lane opens.
Communicate verbally and non-verbally.
Move to create new passing angles after each touch.

title: 2 v 2 Net Front Corner Battles with Support
description: A competitive corner and net-front battle game with point support. Teams fight to recover the puck, use board passes or rims to the point, and create shots, tips, and redirects.
coaching_points: Establish body position before trying to win the puck.
Use board passes and rims to available point support.
Point players move the puck quickly before pressure arrives.
Defenders keep sticks down to angle and close passing lanes.

title: 2 on 2 Box Out
description: A two-part progression that starts with a net-front box-out battle on a point shot and then sends the same players into a 2-on-2 rush down the ice.
coaching_points: Defenders box out and eliminate sticks at the net.
Forwards find soft areas for tips and rebounds.
On the rush, attackers use width, passing, and changes of speed.
Defenders maintain a tight gap and angle the attack outside.

title: Pass Through The Cones 2 v 2 Game
description: A station-based 2-on-2 game where teams score by completing passes through cone or tire gates, forcing players to scan, support the puck, protect possession, and manipulate passing lanes.
coaching_points: Puck carriers keep their heads up to locate open gates and support.
Players without the puck jump into open space.
Defenders keep sticks in lanes and communicate.
Do not use the same gate twice in a row.
